description: Identifies and reports all 3D views that do not have a valid or user-defined workset assigned in a workshared project.
edge_cases: Document is not workshared (doc.IsWorkshared is False), rendering workset auditing invalid
View is a view template (view.IsTemplate is True) rather than an actual placed/navigable 3D view
The ELEM_PARTITION_PARAM parameter is null, read-only, or uninitialized on the view element
View is a temporary, revision, or internal system view (e.g., default {3D} view in a transient state)
